facts.headline: All ages • Approx. 11 Hours
facts.description: The Real Florida Adventure Approx. 11 Hours. This Tour You've come all the way to Florida, so it makes sense to actually see as much of it as possible, and no other tour provides such a wide-ranging, in-depth experience as our carefully crafted Real Florida Adventure. This action-packed day an overview of what's in store as we head out to the beautiful Crystal River area on the Gulf coast, 80 miles north-west of Orlando. This is the Manatee Capital of the World, and the only place in America where it is legal to swim with manatees. It is also home to stunning natural springs and lots of wildlife, and you'll get to meet an essential part of it as we gear up for the signature Manatee Snorkel under the supervision of a Coast Guard Certified Captain . You will learn all about the unique West Indian manatee - and then get to see some of them, up close and personal in the crystal-clear waters! Then we head off to 210-acre Homosassa Springs State Park, a genuine hidden gem of Florida nature, where there is plentiful local wildlife to see and hear about, including the endangered Florida panther, black bears, red wolves, bobcats and alligators, as well as a profusion of birdlife, notably whooping cranes and flamingos. Also here is the unique sight of Nature's Fish Bowl, an underwater observatory built over the mouth of the main spring where a huge number of fish hang out, while the Park has its own manatee rehabilitation program to provide another exciting glimpse of these rare sea mammals. Lunch is included, here, too. Finally, the day will conclude with an exciting airboat ride on the Withlacoochee River, another natural haven where you can see more wildlife in its natural habitat and enjoy the thrill of skimming the water at up to 45mph in these exhilarating, flat-bottomed craft. NB: any person wishing to do the manatee swim must hire a wetsuit prior to boat departure. Wetsuit rental is handled when you arrive at the manatee boat tour. Snorkel equipment is provided free. Flotation devices are available for your use. Life vests are available if needed. Inclusions Boat tour of Kings Bay and Crystal River Complimentary Mask and Snorkel Packed Lunch provided by Publix: 6 inch ultimate sub on white bread, tavern ham, OvenGold turkey breast, top round roast beef, and Provolone cheese, lettuce and tomato, bag of chips, 2 cookies, 1 drink. facts.description: Kennedy Space Center Admission With Transportation Approx. 10.5 Hours. This Tour Welcome to the home of One Small Step for Man. In simple terms, this is one of the most essential - and thrilling - attractions in Florida, and it is as real as it comes in terms of a dynamic, visceral place to visit. Not only does the Space Center offer the past, present and future of the space program, it puts visitors front and center in the whole experience like never before. Seeing is believing, and you will believe you have been transported to the cutting edge of space exploration through a series of hands-on exhibits, movies, and presentations, including a daily Astronaut Encounter with one of the modern heroes of NASA's operations. It all starts with the signature Bus Tour that provides a complete overview of the full extent of the vast spread of operations, including the massive Vehicle Assembly Building, Launch Complex 39B, and the Apollo/Saturn V Center, with its recreated moon landing and awesome full-size Saturn V rocket. Back at the main Visitor Complex, you should definitely make a beeline for the hugely impressive Space Shuttle Atlantis exhibit, with its moving and emotional presentation of one of the four surviving orbiters, as well as take a ride on the riveting Shuttle Launch Experience, a clever simulator with the inside track on what it feels like to blast off from the Space Center. You can also visit the Heroes & Legends center (including the U.S. Astronaut Hall of Fame), soak up the grandeur of the IMAX Theater with its eye-popping large-screen movies, and wander the Rocket Garden. There is SO much to see here, you will definitely need all day to take it all in, and our Admission with Transportation is the perfect way to indulge your inner astronaut! The KSC is fully 60 miles from Orlando, so let us take the strain out of the journey and you can enjoy the experience to the max - the IMAX. facts.headline: All ages • Approx. 10.5 Hours
facts.description: Kennedy Space Center Ultimate Package Approx. 10.5 Hours. This Tour When you want to immerse yourself completely in the space center vibe, this is the adventure for you - transportation and admission to the Visitor Complex, plenty of time to explore all that's on offer, then the superb Dine with an Astronaut option, and finally a trip ‘behind the gates' for a two-hour Discover KSC bus tour. We rightly label this our ‘Ultimate' tour as it maximizes every moment at the Space Center with a full-on and in-depth exploration that touches on all the key aspects of the space program. First, there is the chance to get up close and personal with exhibits like the essential Space Shuttle Atlantis (don't miss this, as it packs a really emotional punch with its big ‘reveal'), the Shuttle Launch Experience, Heroes & Legends center, extensive Rocket Garden, and IMAX Theater. Once you have soaked up NASA's past, present and future, we'll take you on to the highlight of lunch with one of their veterans, and a chance to hear first-hand about what it takes to be a member of the astronaut corps. Along with a tasty meal, you will have an opportunity to ask questions and have your photograph taken with him or her for a unique souvenir. Then it's time to spread your wings a little and head out to see more of the full 144,000-acre extent of the KSC, which was founded in 1962 by President Kennedy and has been growing ever since. This unique behind-the-scenes bus tour provides rare close-up views of the signature sights such as the gigantic Vehicle Assembly Building - the tallest one-story structure in the world - the historic launch sites and other operational facilities before concluding at the fascinating Apollo/Saturn V Center, home to a full-size Saturn V rocket, a moon-landing recreation, and a piece of moon-rock you can actually touch. It's as close as you can get to being an astronaut without actually joining NASA! facts.headline: All ages • Approx. 10.5 Hours
facts.description: Kennedy Space Center Chat with an Astronaut Approx. 10.5 Hours. This Tour When you want to take your space exploration a step further, what better way to enjoy the KSC than with one of the people who actually makes it all happen - one of NASA's very own astronauts. Not only will you be whisked to the Visitor Complex with all the convenience and efficiency of Real Florida Adventures transport, you will also be first in line for one of THE great personalized experiences the Space Center has to offer. Set in a purpose-designed intimate venue at the Visitors Complex you will be introduced to some common astronaut traditions before engaging in a question and answer with one of NASA's amazing Astronauts. During this 45 minute to an hour session, you'll be able to ask those well thought out questions to see what it's really like to work for NASA and be one of the few to travel into orbit. During the Chat enjoy a sampling of food and beverage while having your group conversation. Each guest will receive a commemorative gift and a lithograph (signed portrait) of the astronaut. Of course, you will still have plenty of time to explore the rest of the Space Center and soak up the amazing, dynamic vibe of the modern KSC, which has been dramatically revamped in recent years to really immerse visitors in both the history and the future of space exploration. There is a LOT to discover, but don't miss the awe-inspiring Space Shuttle Atlantis exhibit, complete with the Shuttle Launch Experience, the Heroes & Legends center, incorporating the U.S. Astronaut Hall of Fame, the majestic Rocket Garden, and the fabulous IMAX Theater, with its larger-than-life movie features. facts.headline: All ages • Approx. 10.5 Hours
facts.description: Kennedy Space Center Dine with an Astronaut Approx. 10.5 Hours. This Tour We know there is a LOT to fit into your Orlando vacation, which is why we've designed this classic combination that twins the essential excitement of the Kennedy Space Center with the thrills of an airboat ride and the chance to enjoy some of the real, natural Florida. It may seem strange to combine the high-tech world of the KSC with the rural nature of airboating, but the fact is the Space Center is surrounded by conservation areas and wildlife refuges, so there is a strong link between the two, and you will get the full effect of ultra-modern and natural all on this one tour. It all starts with a gentle drive out to Brevard County where the first part of your adventure awaits on the St. Johns River. Here, on the longest river in Florida, your airboat captain will showcase the natural splendors of Central Florida with an unforgettable ride on one of these unique, flat-bottomed craft that are powered by a giant propeller. Skimming along the river and its surrounding wetlands at up to 45mph, you will catch glimpses of alligators, turtles and other wildlife that make the river their home, including the state's abundance of birdlife, from egrets and herons to eagles and ospreys. After your nature experience, it's time to head to the home of One Small Step For Man and a complete immersion in the world of NASA and its astronauts. You will have the rest of the day to explore the Visitor Center and soak up the vast array of exhibits and presentations that provide the full lowdown on the past, present and future of the space program as it gears up for a return to the moon, and on to Mars. Be sure to visit the superb Space Shuttle Atlantis exhibit for one of the most emotional tributes to the former earth orbiter, as well as the Shuttle Launch Experience and a host of hands-on opportunities. facts.headline: Ages 3 and up • Approx. 11 Hours
factualSentences: Use promo-code DIRECT10 to receive 10% off tickets!
facts.description: The Real Florida Adventure BOOK DIRECT BONUS! Use promo-code DIRECT10 to receive 10% off tickets! Approx. 11 Hours. This Tour You've come all the way to Florida, so it makes sense to actually see as much of it as possible, and no other tour provides such a wide-ranging, in-depth experience as our carefully crafted Real Florida Adventure. This action-packed day starts with a full overview of what's in store as we head out to the beautiful Crystal River area on the Gulf coast, 80 miles north-west of Orlando. This is the Manatee Capital of the World, and the only place in America where it is legal to swim with manatees. It is also home to stunning natural springs and lots of wildlife, and you'll get to meet an essential part of it as we gear up for the signature Manatee Snorkel under the supervision of a Coast Guard Certified Captain . You will learn all about the unique West Indian manatee - and then get to see some of them, up close and personal in the crystal-clear waters! Then we head off to 210-acre Homosassa Springs State Park, a genuine hidden gem of Florida nature, where there is plentiful local wildlife to see and hear about, including the endangered Florida panther, black bears, red wolves, bobcats and alligators, as well as a profusion of birdlife, notably whooping cranes and flamingos. Also here is the unique sight of Nature's Fish Bowl, an underwater observatory built over the mouth of the main spring where a huge number of fish hang out, while the Park has its own manatee rehabilitation program to provide another exciting glimpse of these rare sea mammals. Lunch is included, here, too. Finally, the day will conclude with an exciting airboat ride on the Withlacoochee River, another natural haven where you can see more wildlife in its natural habitat and enjoy the thrill of skimming the water at up to 45mph in these exhilarating, flat-bottomed craft. NB: any person wishing to do the manatee swim must hire a wetsuit prior to boat departure. Snorkel equipment is provided free. facts.description: Kennedy Space Center Direct Express Approx. 10.5 Hours. This Tour One Pickup, One Drop Off. Leave directly from the Orlando Starflyer at ICON Park and be the first drop off at the end of the day! Direct Express both there and back! Welcome to the home of One Small Step for Man. In simple terms, this is one of the most essential - and thrilling - attractions in Florida, and it is as real as it comes in terms of a dynamic, visceral place to visit. Not only does the Space Center offer the past, present and future of the space program, it puts visitors front and center in the whole experience like never before. Seeing is believing, and you will believe you have been transported to the cutting edge of space exploration through a series of hands-on exhibits, movies, and presentations, including a daily Astronaut Encounter with one of the modern heroes of NASA's operations. It all starts with the signature Bus Tour that provides a complete overview of the full extent of the vast spread of operations, including the massive Vehicle Assembly Building, Launch Complex 39B, and the Apollo/Saturn V Center, with its recreated moon landing and awesome full-size Saturn V rocket. Back at the main Visitor Complex, you should definitely make a beeline for the hugely impressive Space Shuttle Atlantis exhibit, with its moving and emotional presentation of one of the four surviving orbiters, as well as take a ride on the riveting Shuttle Launch Experience, a clever simulator with the inside track on what it feels like to blast off from the Space Center. You can also visit the Heroes & Legends center (including the U.S. Astronaut Hall of Fame), soak up the grandeur of the IMAX Theater with its eye-popping large-screen movies, and wander the Rocket Garden. There is SO much to see here, you will definitely need all day to take it all in, and our Admission with Transportation is the perfect way to indulge your inner astronaut! The KSC is fully 60 miles from Orlando, so let us take the strain out of the journey and you can enjoy the experience to the max - the IMAX.
